# Perch

> Perch is a free Mac app (beta) for people who run several Claude Code sessions at once. It keeps every session, PR, and link for a piece of work in one place, stays quiet while you focus, and tells you when something needs you.

Tagline: Do one thing. Perch watches the rest.

## What it does

- Each piece of work is a "context" with its own Claude Code session, next steps, status, PRs, links, and notes.
- The dashboard groups contexts by whose move it is: yours, waiting on a teammate or reviewer, Claude working, or idle.
- Notifications arrive only when a session needs input or approval, a PR gets review comments, or CI fails. Perch stays silent about the context you are looking at.
- Chat view shows the conversation with formatted replies and a message box. Terminal view is the real Claude Code CLI.
- Every next step has an owner (you, Claude, or a teammate), and Claude keeps a one-line status as it works.
- PRs are detected automatically across repos and worktrees, with review state, CI checks, and who you are waiting on (via the GitHub CLI).
- Deep focus mutes every other context so you can stay with one.
- Sessions keep running when you quit or update Perch.
- Existing Claude Code sessions can be imported and resumed where they left off.
- Updates install with one click and keep sessions running.

## Who it is for

Engineers who juggle parallel Claude Code work, and non-engineers (product managers, designers, analysts, writers) who use Claude Code without wanting to live in a terminal. Setup guides you through installing and signing in to Claude Code.

## Requirements

- macOS on Apple Silicon
- Claude Code (Perch can install it for you)
- GitHub CLI, optional, for PR states

## Privacy

- Contexts, notes, and status live in a local database on your Mac. No account and no Perch servers.
- No analytics or usage tracking. Crash reports are off unless you turn them on, and never include prompts, terminal output, or code.
- GitHub access goes through your own gh login. Claude Code talks to Anthropic exactly as it does without Perch.
